mutateBoundedIssueReaction.reason: Only the existing single-target issue-record reaction callback uses this adapter. Retains canonical issue/content inputs and non-discussion persistence, global native reference refresh, sorted metadata rebase, exact scoped project-progress contributions and warm import compaction conflicts. No full-writer counts, PreviousValues or account write; restores native viewer/role and installs last=false. Output/admission stays owned through publication and response. SW116 compares both literal topologies across 66 warm/reloaded/error/native cases, SQL/index/event/search/webhook effects and cancellation/retry/release; SW117 proves actual ordinary and alias routes. Shared proof includes persistent SQLite twice and race.
